title: A Style-Based Generator Architecture for Generative Adversarial Networks
summary: A short demo video for NVIDIA's StyleGAN paper, which proposes a style-based generator for GANs. It shows face synthesis with style mixing and scale-specific control over attributes like pose and freckles.
why: Cited as an example of how realistic GAN-generated faces had become, and of what a well-structured latent space can do.

quote.text: The latest generator in this list has very powerful latent spaces, including approximately accurate 3D rotations.
